subject: Marketplace daily sampling loss & VAT delegation
messages:
From: Lisa Moore <billing@acme-payments.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Daily sample gaps in marketplace metering (sample attached)

Hi Evelyn —

We pulled a daily sampling report this morning and noticed a recurring drop in recorded usage for a subset of endpoints between 00:00–01:00 UTC on Nov 19–23. I attached a 48-line CSV (usage_sample.csv) showing the first-party ledger vs. AWS delivered batches — you can see several expected ticks are missing.

This is causing an out-of-balance on our month-to-date invoice and will trigger a VAT reclaim when we reconcile. Can you confirm whether Redwood runs any daily aggregation cutoff that could drop partial-day samples? If not, we need a short root cause and a proposal for retroactive meter re-ingestion so we can finalize Nov invoices.

Also: our tax team is asking whether Redwood can accept VAT delegation (signed certificate attached) so they don't need to submit per-invoice certificates. We can send the formal delegation if it's supported.

Thanks — appreciate a quick read.

Lisa Moore
Director, Billing & Collections
Acme Payments
attachments: usage_sample.csv

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Moore <billing@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Daily sample gaps in marketplace metering (sample attached)

Hi Lisa —

Thanks for the sample, and for flagging the VAT delegation question up front. We got the CSV and I started a quick triage. Two quick clarifying asks before we scope a replay:

- Are the missing ticks all on accounts that show burst traffic around midnight PST? (helps isolate window boundary behavior)
- Can you confirm whether any of the records came from Marketplace "async ingestion" (you can see that in the left-most column of your export).

Proposed immediate steps from us:
- Karthik will run a prefix-level scan across Nov 18–24 to confirm whether a daily cut/flush dropped partial buffers.
- If we identify dropped batches, we can pull the retained raw shards and request a re-ingest via AWS marketplace support (we've done this flow twice for other customers).
- For VAT delegation: we can accept a signed delegation letter. Our compliance team will need the PDF certificate and a signed DPA addendum; happy to walk Acme's tax contact through the process.

I'm looping Karthik for the technical check and Jonas to own the customer coordination + timeline. We'll aim to get an initial root cause within 48 hours.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Lisa Moore <billing@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Daily sample gaps in marketplace metering (sample attached)

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 10:02 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the sample...

Hi all — quick technical note from the runtime side after an initial scan of the CSV and our shard logs:

- Root cause candidate: we see a pattern where our "day-slice" cut runs at 00:00 UTC and closes active batched writers for high-volume accounts. For accounts that emit a short burst exactly at the cut boundary, a micro-batch can be moved to a transient cache shard and the metadata marker was not promoted to the final batch file in two observed cases (Nov 20 & 22). That explains the missing ticks rather than a wholesale marketplace export gap.

- Impact: ~0.07% of daily tokens for the affected tenant group (small but visible for monthly aggregation when multiplied across SKUs).

- Immediate remediation: we can do a targeted replay for the affected prefixes by pulling the retention shard (we keep 7 days of raw shards). This requires: 1) Acme to confirm the affected tenant IDs and 2) AWS Marketplace support to accept a controlled re-ingest request (we'll open a support case and include sample batch checksums).

- For VAT delegation: functionally we accept the delegation PDF but our compliance team requires a signed DPA addendum to the existing contract and a named tax contact for audit trail. Jonas, can you coordinate the DPA addendum and confirm the contact?

Technical checklist I'm attaching in the case notes:
- sample checksums (from usage_sample.csv)
- shard IDs and retention window
- proposed replay manifest (will post to the shared Drive once Acme confirms tenant list)

I'll open the AWS case now and paste the ID into the thread.

—Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Moore <billing@acme-payments.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Daily sample gaps in marketplace metering (sample attached)

Hi Lisa — thanks for the quick patience. Summary / proposed plan: 

1) Root cause: transient promotion gap at our 00:00 UTC day-slice boundary for a narrow tenant prefix group (Karthik confirmed).
2) Action plan: targeted replay for tenant IDs you confirm; Redwood opens AWS Marketplace support case and requests controlled re-ingest. ETA: 5 business days after tenant confirmation + AWS acceptance.
3) VAT: Redwood will accept the VAT delegation PDF but needs the signed DPA addendum and a named tax contact (upload to our secure Drive link below). Once we have that, we can record the delegation in our compliance ledger and avoid per-invoice certificate exchanges.

Next steps for Acme (please confirm by EOD Friday):
- Share the list of affected tenant IDs (or say "all from sample", if you prefer)
- Upload signed VAT delegation + DPA addendum to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sample-recon

Redwood next steps (we'll do the following once you confirm tenants):
- Post the replay manifest to Drive and open AWS case reference: AWS-789047 (I will update this thread)
- Deliver a reconciliation statement (acct_statement_q3.csv) and invoice adjustments if the replay yields new metering lines

Attachments: acct_statement_q3.csv (provisional), vat_certificate_acme.pdf (placeholder received)

If that timeline works, I'll drop a calendar invite for a 30-minute reconciliation readout and lock the replay window.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: acct_statement_q3.csv, vat_certificate_acme.pdf
